name: BritCham Singapore
summary: British Chamber of Commerce for UK-linked business networking, advocacy, and SME-friendly event calendars.
body: BritCham connects UK and Commonwealth business communities through events, advocacy, and sector programming. Strong for entrepreneurs and corporate professionals building a Singapore network without defaulting to a country-club fee. Compare corporate vs SME tiers against how many introductions you actually convert in six months. Pair with BritCham’s social calendar only as a secondary belonging channel — primary friendships usually come from hobbies and nationality associations.
membershipNotes: Corporate and SME tiers — check current schedule of fees.
